quranTranslation.text: And verily We inspired Moses, saying: Take away My slaves by night and strike for them a dry path in the sea, fearing not to be overtaken, neither being afraid (of the sea).

explanation.bs: „Pa im udari kroz more suh put“ – doslovni put.
explanation.en: “Strike for them a dry path in the sea” — a literal road.

quranTranslation.text: They said: O our people! Lo! we have heard a scripture which hath been revealed after Moses, confirming that which was before it, guiding unto the truth and a right road.

explanation.bs: Džini o Knjizi koja upućuje istini i na pravi put.
explanation.en: The jinn on the Book that guides to the truth and to a straight way.

quranTranslation.text: Except the road of hell, wherein they will abide for ever. And that is ever easy for Allah.

explanation.bs: Osim na put u Džehennem – preneseno: kraj kojem put vodi.
explanation.en: Except the path of Hell — figurative: the end a road leads to.

quranTranslation.text: The likeness of those who spend their wealth in Allah's way is as the likeness of a grain which groweth seven ears, in every ear a hundred grains. Allah giveth increase manifold to whom He will. Allah is All-Embracing, All-Knowing.

explanation.bs: Oni koji udjeljuju imetke svoje na Allahovom putu – put kao razlog.
explanation.en: Those who spend their wealth in the way of Allah — the way as a cause.

quranTranslation.text: Call unto the way of thy Lord with wisdom and fair exhortation, and reason with them in the better way. Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth from His way, and He is Best Aware of those who go aright.

explanation.bs: „Pozivaj na put svoga Gospodara mudrošću i lijepim savjetom.“
explanation.en: “Call unto the way of thy Lord with wisdom and fair exhortation.”

quranTranslation.text: Show us the straight path,

explanation.bs: „Vodi nas pravim putem.“
explanation.en: “Show us the straight path.”

quranTranslation.text: The path of Allah, unto Whom belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth. Do not all things reach Allah at last?

explanation.bs: Put Allaha, kome pripada sve što je na nebesima i sve što je na Zemlji.
explanation.en: “The path of Allah, unto Whom belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth.”

quranTranslation.text: When he saw a fire and said unto his folk: Lo! Wait! I see a fire afar off. Peradventure I may bring you a brand therefrom or may find guidance at the fire.

explanation.bs: Musa je ugledao vatru – vatra na dunjaluku (u tefsiru se raspravlja je li bila obična vatra ili svjetlo).
explanation.en: Moses saw a fire — a fire in this world (tafsir discusses whether it was ordinary fire or a light).

quranTranslation.text: We said: O fire, be coolness and peace for Abraham,

explanation.bs: „O vatro, budi hladnoća i spas Ibrahimu!“
explanation.en: “O fire, be coolness and peace for Abraham.”

quranTranslation.text: And if ye do it not - and ye can never do it - then guard yourselves against the Fire prepared for disbelievers, whose fuel is of men and stones.

explanation.bs: „Čuvajte se vatre čije su gorivo ljudi i kamenje“ – vatra na ahiretu.
explanation.en: “Guard yourselves against the Fire … whose fuel is of men and stones” — the Fire of the hereafter.

quranTranslation.text: They said: Build for him a building and fling him in the red-hotfire.

explanation.bs: „Pa ga bacite u oganj!“ – Ibrahimovi neprijatelji o vatri koju su zapalili: jedino dunjalučko جَحِيم.
explanation.en: Ibrāhīm's enemies order him flung into the blazing fire they lit: the one worldly use of جَحِيم.

quranTranslation.text: And when hell is lighted,

explanation.bs: „I kad se oganj razbukta“ – جَحِيم uz glagol iz korijena سعر.
explanation.en: “And when hell is lighted” — جَحِيم with a verb from the root of سَعِير.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! hell will be his home.

explanation.bs: Onome ko je bio obijestan, prebivalište će biti oganj – opomena.
explanation.en: For the one who transgressed, Hellfire will be the refuge — a warning.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! Those who devour the wealth of orphans wrongfully, they do but swallow fire into their bellies, and they will be exposed to burning flame.

explanation.bs: Oni koji nepravedno jedu imetke siročadi gorjet će u ognju – opomena za nepravdu prema siročadi.
explanation.en: Those who devour orphans' property unjustly will be burned in a Blaze — a warning against wronging orphans.

quranTranslation.text: And verily We have beautified the world's heaven with lamps, and We have made them missiles for the devils, and for them We have prepared the doom of flame.

explanation.bs: Šejtanima je pripremljena patnja u ognju – عَذَاب السَّعِير.
explanation.en: For the devils is prepared the punishment of the Blaze — عَذَاب السَّعِير.

quranTranslation.text: And thus We have inspired in thee a Lecture in Arabic, that thou mayst warn the mother-town and those around it, and mayst warn of a day of assembling whereof there is no doubt. A host will be in the Garden, and a host of them in the Flame.

explanation.bs: „Jedna skupina u Džennetu, a druga skupina u razbuktalom ognju“ – سَعِير nasuprot Džennetu.
explanation.en: “A host will be in the Garden, and a host of them in the Flame” — سَعِير set against Paradise.

quranTranslation.text: The pilgrimage is (in) the well-known months, and whoever is minded to perform the pilgrimage therein (let him remember that) there is (to be) no lewdness nor abuse nor angry conversation on the pilgrimage. And whatsoever good ye do Allah knoweth it. So make provision for yourselves (Hereafter); for the best provision is to ward off evil. Therefore keep your duty unto Me, O men of understanding.

explanation.bs: „Hadž ima svoje poznate mjesece“ – hadž vezan za vrijeme.
explanation.en: “The pilgrimage is (in) the well-known months” — hajj bound to its time.

quranTranslation.text: Wherein are plain memorials (of Allah's guidance); the place where Abraham stood up to pray; and whosoever entereth it is safe. And pilgrimage to the House is a duty unto Allah for mankind, for him who can find a way thither. As for him who disbelieveth, (let him know that) lo! Allah is Independent of (all) creatures.

explanation.bs: „Allahovo je pravo nad ljudima hodočašće Kuće (حِجُّ الْبَيْتِ) – za onoga ko može do nje doći“ – hadž kao obaveza.
explanation.en: “Pilgrimage to the House is a duty unto Allah for mankind, for him who can find a way thither” — hajj as a duty.

quranTranslation.text: And proclaim unto mankind the pilgrimage. They will come unto thee on foot and on every lean camel; they will come from every deep ravine,

explanation.bs: „I oglasi među ljudima hadž“ – Ibrahimov poziv na hodočašće.
explanation.en: “And proclaim unto mankind the pilgrimage” — Abraham's call to the pilgrimage.

quranTranslation.text: Perform the pilgrimage and the visit (to Makka) for Allah. And if ye are prevented, then send such gifts as can be obtained with ease, and shave not your heads until the gifts have reached their destination. And whoever among you is sick or hath an ailment of the head must pay a ransom of fasting or almsgiving or offering. And if ye are in safety, then whosoever contenteth himself with the visit for the pilgrimage (shall give) such gifts as can be had with ease. And whosoever cannot find (such gifts), then a fast of three days while on the pilgrimage, and of seven when ye have returned; that is, ten in all. That is for him whoso folk are not present at the Inviolable Place of Worship. Observe your duty to Allah, and know that Allah is severe in punishment.

explanation.bs: „I radi Allaha hadž i umru obavite potpuno“ – obje riječi zajedno; neki učenjaci odatle zaključuju da je i umra obavezna, drugi ne.
explanation.en: “Perform the pilgrimage and the visit (العُمْرَة) for Allah” — both words together; some scholars infer from it that umrah is obligatory too, others do not.

quranTranslation.text: And Job, when he cried unto his Lord, (saying): Lo! adversity afflicteth me, and Thou art Most Merciful of all who show mercy.

explanation.bs: Ejjub: „Mene je dotakla nevolja (مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ), a Ti si najmilostiviji od milostivih“ – nevolja koja dotakne.
explanation.en: Job: “Lo! adversity afflicteth [touches] me, and Thou art Most Merciful of all who show mercy” — harm that touches.

quranTranslation.text: If ye divorce them before ye have touched them and ye have appointed unto them a portion, then (pay the) half of that which ye appointed, unless they (the women) agree to forgo it, or he agreeth to forgo it in whose hand is the marriage tie. To forgo is nearer to piety. And forget not kindness among yourselves. Allah is Seer of what ye do.

explanation.bs: „A ako ih razvedete prije nego što ste ih dotakli (تَمَسُّوهُنَّ)…“ – blag izraz za bračni odnos.
explanation.en: “If ye divorce them before ye have touched them…” — a gentle word for consummation.

quranTranslation.text: Which none toucheth save the purified,

explanation.bs: „…koju dotiču samo očišćeni“ – tefsir se razilazi: čisti meleki i Ploča, ili propis o dodirivanju mushafa.
explanation.en: “Which none toucheth save the purified” — tafsir differs: the purified angels and the Tablet, or a ruling on touching the muṣḥaf.

quranTranslation.text: Had we sent down unto thee (Muhammad) (actual) writing upon parchment, so that they could feel it with their hands, those who disbelieve would have said: This is naught else than mere magic.

explanation.bs: „…i da je opipaju vlastitim rukama…“ – opipljivi dodir.
explanation.en: “…so that they could feel it with their hands…” — a touch of the hand.

gloss.en: to touch, to feel; to seek

quranTranslation.text: And (the Jinn who had listened to the Qur'an said): We had sought the heaven but had found it filled with strong warders and meteors.

explanation.bs: „I mi smo tražili nebo (لَمَسْنَا – pokušali dotaći), i našli smo da je ispunjeno strogim čuvarima i plamenovima“ – tefsir: pokušali doseći, tražili.
explanation.en: “We had sought the heaven but had found it filled with strong warders and meteors” — tafsir: tried to reach it, sought it.

gloss.en: to touch, to feel; to seek

quranTranslation.text: There is not an animal in the earth, nor a flying creature flying on two wings, but they are peoples like unto you. We have neglected nothing in the Book (of Our decrees). Then unto their Lord they will be gathered.

explanation.bs: „Nema nijednog stvora na zemlji … a da nisu zajednice poput vas“ – zajednice po vrsti i načinu života.
explanation.en: “There is not an animal in the earth … but they are peoples like unto you” — communities by kind and way of life.

quranTranslation.text: Ye are the best community that hath been raised up for mankind. Ye enjoin right conduct and forbid indecency; and ye believe in Allah. And if the People of the Scripture had believed it had been better for them. Some of them are believers; but most of them are evil-livers.

explanation.bs: „Vi ste najbolja zajednica (خَيْرَ أُمَّةٍ) koja je izvedena ljudima“ – zajednica spojena vjerom.
explanation.en: “Ye are the best community (خَيْرَ أُمَّةٍ) that hath been raised up for mankind” — a community joined by faith.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! Abraham was a nation obedient to Allah, by nature upright, and he was not of the idolaters;

explanation.bs: „Ibrahim je zaista bio أُمَّة, ponizno pokoran Allahu“ – ar-Rāġib: sam kao cijela zajednica u ibadetu.
explanation.en: “Lo! Abraham was a nation (أُمَّة) obedient to Allah” — ar-Rāġib: alone like a whole community in worship.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Let not a folk deride a folk who may be better than they (are), not let women (deride) women who may be better than they are; neither defame one another, nor insult one another by nicknames. Bad is the name of lewdness after faith. And whoso turneth not in repentance, such are evil-doers.

explanation.bs: „Neka se ljudi (قَوْم) ne izruguju drugim ljudima … niti žene drugim ženama“ – ar-Rāġib: pošto se zatim spominju žene, ovdje قَوْم znači muškarce.
explanation.en: “Let not a folk (قَوْم) deride a folk … let women (deride) women” — ar-Rāġib: since women are named next, here قَوْم means men.

quranTranslation.text: We sent Noah (of old) unto his people, and he said: O my people! Serve Allah. Ye have no other Allah save Him. Lo! I fear for you the retribution of an Awful Day.

explanation.bs: Nuh: „Narode moj, obožavajte Allaha“ – vjerovjesnikov narod.
explanation.en: Noah: “O my people! Serve Allah” — a prophet's people.

quranTranslation.text: For him are angels ranged before him and behind him, who guard him by Allah's command. Lo! Allah changeth not the condition of a folk until they (first) change that which is in their hearts; and if Allah willeth misfortune for a folk there is none that can repel it, nor have they a defender beside Him.

explanation.bs: „Allah zaista ne mijenja stanje jednog naroda sve dok oni ne izmijene ono što je u njima samima.“
explanation.en: “Lo! Allah changeth not the condition of a folk until they (first) change that which is in their hearts.”

quranTranslation.text: So the earthquake seized them, and morning found them prostrate in their dwelling-place.

explanation.bs: Semud: „I zahvati ih potres…“ – što 11:67 naziva krikom; mnogi mufessiri to shvaćaju kao jednu kaznu viđenu s dvije strane.
explanation.en: Thamud: “So the earthquake seized them…” — which 11:67 calls the shriek; many mufassirun take it as one punishment seen from two sides.

quranTranslation.text: So the earthquake seized them and morning found them prostrate in their dwelling-place.

explanation.bs: Medjen, Šuajbov narod: „I zahvati ih potres…“ – što 11:94 naziva krikom; mnogi mufessiri to shvaćaju kao jednu kaznu viđenu s dvije strane.
explanation.en: Midian, the people of Shuʿayb: “So the earthquake seized them…” — which 11:94 calls the shriek; many mufassirun take it as one punishment seen from two sides.

quranTranslation.text: And the (awful) Cry overtook those who did wrong, so that morning found them prostrate in their dwellings,

explanation.bs: Semud: „A one koji su činili nepravdu zahvati krik, pa osvanuše u svojim kućama mrtvi, nepomični.“
explanation.en: Thamud: “And the (awful) Cry overtook those who did wrong, so that morning found them prostrate in their dwellings.”

quranTranslation.text: Then the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the sunrise.

explanation.bs: Lutov narod: „I zahvati ih krik pri izlasku sunca“ – ar-Rāġib: ovdje krik u značenju straha.
explanation.en: Lot's people: “Then the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the sunrise” — ar-Rāġib: here the shriek in the sense of terror.

quranTranslation.text: The day when they will hear the (Awful) Cry in truth. That is the day of coming forth (from the graves).

explanation.bs: „Na Dan kada će uistinu čuti krik“ – ar-Rāġib: puhanje u rog.
explanation.en: “The day when they will hear the (Awful) Cry in truth” — ar-Rāġib: the blowing of the Horn.

quranTranslation.text: And as for Thamud, We gave them guidance, but they preferred blindness to the guidance, so the bolt of the doom of humiliation overtook them because of what they used to earn.

explanation.bs: Semud: „…pa ih je zahvatila munja ponižavajuće kazne“ – treća riječ za istu propast.
explanation.en: Thamud: “…so the bolt of the doom of humiliation overtook them” — a third word for the same ruin.

quranTranslation.text: But if they turn away, then say: I warn you of a thunderbolt like the thunderbolt (which fell of old upon the tribes) of A'ad and Thamud;

explanation.bs: „Upozoravam vas na munju kakva je bila munja Ada i Semuda“ – ar-Rāġib (prenoseći neke jezikoslovce): munja kao kazna.
explanation.en: “I warn you of a thunderbolt like the thunderbolt (which fell of old upon the tribes) of A'ad and Thamud” — ar-Rāġib (reporting some linguists): the thunderbolt as punishment.

quranTranslation.text: The thunder hymneth His praise and (so do) the angels for awe of Him. He launcheth the thunderbolts and smiteth with them whom He will while they dispute (in doubt) concerning Allah, and He is mighty in wrath.

explanation.bs: „…i šalje munje te njima pogađa koga hoće“ – šalje ih Allah i usmjerava.
explanation.en: “…He launcheth the thunderbolts and smiteth with them whom He will” — sent and aimed by Allah.

quranTranslation.text: Say: Shall I seek another than Allah for Lord, when He is Lord of all things? Each soul earneth only on its own account, nor doth any laden bear another's load. Then unto your Lord is your return and He will tell you that wherein ye differed.

explanation.bs: „…i nijedan nosilac bremena neće nositi tuđe breme“ – grijeh se ne prenosi s jednog na drugog.
explanation.en: “…nor doth any laden bear another's load (وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ)” — sin does not pass from one to another.

quranTranslation.text: That they may bear their burdens undiminished on the Day of Resurrection, with somewhat of the burdens of those whom they mislead without knowledge. Ah! evil is that which they bear!

explanation.bs: „Da bi na Sudnjem danu nosili svoja bremena u potpunosti, i dio bremena onih koje bez znanja zavode“ – ar-Rāġib: kao 29:13.
explanation.en: “That they may bear their burdens undiminished on the Day of Resurrection, with somewhat of the burdens of those whom they mislead” — ar-Rāġib: like 29:13.

quranTranslation.text: They said: We broke not tryst with thee of our own will, but we were laden with burdens of ornaments of the folk, then cast them (in the fire), for thus As-Samiri proposed.

explanation.bs: „…nego smo bili natovareni bremenima od nakita naroda“ – breme u doslovnom smislu.
explanation.en: “…but we were laden with burdens of ornaments of the folk” — burdens in the literal sense.

quranTranslation.text: And they bear your loads for you unto a land ye could not reach save with great trouble to yourselves. Lo! your Lord is Full of Pity, Merciful.

explanation.bs: „I nose vaše terete do mjesta…“ – ar-Rāġib: vaši teški tovari.
explanation.en: “And they bear your loads for you unto a land…” — ar-Rāġib: your heavy loads.

quranTranslation.text: But they verily will bear their own loads and other loads beside their own, and they verily will be questioned on the Day of Resurrection concerning that which they invented.

explanation.bs: „A zaista će nositi svoje terete, i druge terete uz svoje terete“ – ar-Rāġib: grijesi koji ih pritišću.
explanation.en: “But they verily will bear their own loads and other loads beside their own” — ar-Rāġib: the sins that weigh them down.

quranTranslation.text: And Earth yieldeth up her burdens,

explanation.bs: „I kad zemlja izbaci svoje terete“ – ar-Rāġib prenosi dva tumačenja: njena blaga, ili tijela umrlih pri proživljenju.
explanation.en: “And Earth yieldeth up her burdens (أَثْقَالَهَا)” — ar-Rāġib reports two readings: its treasures, or the bodies of the dead at the resurrection.

quranTranslation.text: He created the heavens and the earth with truth, and He shaped you and made good your shapes, and unto Him is the journeying.

explanation.bs: „… i oblikovao vas je, pa je likove vaše lijepim učinio“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “… and He shaped you and made good your shapes” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to form, to give a form

quranTranslation.text: He it is Who fashioneth you in the wombs as pleaseth Him. There is no Allah save Him, the Almighty, the Wise.

explanation.bs: „On je Taj Koji vas oblikuje u maternicama kako hoće“ – lik se daje još prije rođenja; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “He it is Who fashioneth you in the wombs as pleaseth Him” — the form is given before birth; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to form, to give a form

quranTranslation.text: And We created you, then fashioned you, then told the angels: Fall ye prostrate before Adam! And they fell prostrate, all save Iblis, who was not of those who make prostration.

explanation.bs: „I Mi smo vas, zaista, stvorili, zatim vas oblikovali“ – oblikovanje dolazi nakon stvaranja.
explanation.en: “And We created you, then fashioned you” — forming follows creating.

gloss.en: to form, to give a form

quranTranslation.text: Who createth, then disposeth;

explanation.bs: „Koji stvara, pa skladnim čini“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet; odmah zatim dolazi „i Koji određuje mjeru“ (87:3) (قَدَّرَ).
explanation.en: “Who createth, then disposeth [i.e. proportioneth]” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah; right after it comes “Who measureth” (87:3) (قَدَّرَ).

quranTranslation.text: Who created thee, then fashioned, then proportioned thee?

explanation.bs: „Koji te je stvorio, pa te skladnim učinio, pa te uravnotežio“ – ar-Rāġib: učinio je tvoju građu kakvu mudrost traži.
explanation.en: “Who created thee, then fashioned, then proportioned thee?” — ar-Rāġib: He made your creation as wisdom requires.

quranTranslation.text: His comrade, when he (thus) spake with him, exclaimed: Disbelievest thou in Him Who created thee of dust, then of a drop (of seed), and then fashioned thee a man?

explanation.bs: Vjernik svome drugu: „Zar ti poričeš Onoga Koji te je stvorio od zemlje, potom od kapi sjemena, a onda te skladno uobličio u čovjeka?“
explanation.en: The believer to his companion: “Disbelievest thou in Him Who created thee of dust, then of a drop (of seed), and then fashioned thee a man?”

quranTranslation.text: Who measureth, then guideth;

explanation.bs: „I Koji određuje mjeru, pa upućuje“ – ar-Rāġib: svakoj stvari dade ono što joj je na dobro i uputi je.
explanation.en: “Who measureth, then guideth” — ar-Rāġib: He gave each thing what is good for it and guided it.

quranTranslation.text: From a drop of seed. He createth him and proportioneth him,

explanation.bs: „Od kapi sjemena ga je stvorio, pa mu mjeru odredio“ – ar-Rāġib: ono što je u njega položeno pojavljuje se korak po korak.
explanation.en: “From a drop of seed. He createth him and proportioneth [qaddarahu: determineth] him” — ar-Rāġib: what was placed in him appears stage by stage.

quranTranslation.text: For lo! he did consider; then he planned -

explanation.bs: „On je, doista, razmišljao i odmjeravao“ – ljudsko odmjeravanje, koje ar-Rāġib ovdje navodi kao pokuđeno, po želji.
explanation.en: “For lo! he did consider; then he planned” — human measuring, which ar-Rāġib cites here as the blamed kind, by wish.

quranTranslation.text: And We remove whatever rancour may be in their hearts. Rivers flow beneath them. And they say: The praise to Allah, Who hath guided us to this. We could not truly have been led aright if Allah had not guided us. Verily the messengers of our Lord did bring the Truth. And it is cried unto them: This is the Garden. Ye inherit it for what ye used to do.

explanation.bs: „I izvukli smo iz grudi njihovih svaku zlobu; ispod njih rijeke teku“ – o stanovnicima Dženneta; ar-Rāġib navodi ove riječi.
explanation.en: “And We remove whatever rancour may be in their hearts. Rivers flow beneath them” — of the people of Paradise; ar-Rāġib cites these words.

quranTranslation.text: And he drew forth his hand (from his bosom), and lo! it was white for the beholders.

explanation.bs: „Zatim izvuče svoju ruku, i gle – ona bijela, svima koji gledaju“ – Musa.
explanation.en: “And he drew forth his hand (from his bosom), and lo! it was white for the beholders” — Moses.

quranTranslation.text: Say: O Allah! Owner of Sovereignty! Thou givest sovereignty unto whom Thou wilt, and Thou withdrawest sovereignty from whom Thou wilt. Thou exaltest whom Thou wilt, and Thou abasest whom Thou wilt. In Thy hand is the good. Lo! Thou art Able to do all things.

explanation.bs: „Reci: O Allahu, Vlasniče vlasti, Ti vlast daješ kome hoćeš i oduzimaš je od koga hoćeš“ – ovdje nazʿ znači oduzeti, kako Allahu priliči; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Say: O Allah! Owner of Sovereignty! Thou givest sovereignty unto whom Thou wilt, and Thou withdrawest sovereignty from whom Thou wilt” — here nazʿ means taking away, as befits Allah; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: The lightning almost snatcheth away their sight from them. As often as it flasheth forth for them they walk therein, and when it darkeneth against them they stand still. If Allah willed, He could destroy their hearing and their sight. Lo! Allah is able to do all things.

explanation.bs: „Munja zamalo da im ugrabi vid“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “The lightning almost snatcheth away their sight from them” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Save him who snatcheth a fragment, and there pursueth him a piercing flame.

explanation.bs: „Osim onoga koji nešto ugrabi, pa ga stigne prodorna zublja“ – ar-Rāġib: o šejtanima koji kradom prisluškuju.
explanation.en: “Save him who snatcheth a fragment, and there pursueth him a piercing flame” — ar-Rāġib: of the devils who eavesdrop by stealth.

quranTranslation.text: Turning unto Allah (only), not ascribing partners unto Him; for whoso ascribeth partners unto Allah, it is as if he had fallen from the sky and the birds had snatched him or the wind had blown him to a far-off place.

explanation.bs: „… a ko Allahu pripisuje druga – kao da se s neba sručio, a ptice ga ugrabile“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “… for whoso ascribeth partners unto Allah, it is as if he had fallen from the sky and the birds had snatched him” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: O mankind! A similitude is coined, so pay ye heed to it: Lo! those on whom ye call beside Allah will never create a fly though they combine together for the purpose. And if the fly took something from them, they could not rescue it from it. So weak are (both) the seeker and the sought!

explanation.bs: „A kad bi im muha išta otela, ne bi joj to mogli oduzeti natrag“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And if the fly took [yaslubhum: robbed them of] something from them, they could not rescue it from it” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to rob, to take by force
